message.content: I first noticed shortness of breath about two weeks after I had a respiratory infection. Since then it’s gotten worse, now I’m at NYHA class III, and my legs have swelled and I have abdominal pain. I haven’t had any chest pain or dizziness. I don’t recall having a cough, fever, night sweats, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, or any change in my urine or bowel habits.
